displayDescription: Burin hatch bands lay and cross on a paper plate until a light-bulb idea is burnished out of the dark and wired into a red connected system.
audioDescription: Silent preview; no music, effects or narration.
limitations: Engraving is a procedural Canvas 2D approximation: tapered filled polygons stand in for burin grooves; there is no real intaglio ink wiping, plate tone or emboss relief.
Paper grain and the plate-mark are a cached, seeded bitmap texture rather than scanned paper.

STYLE.json lists no tech.preview_recipes and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json was supplied, so the preview shows the primary characteristic action (cross-hatch bands by contour group releasing a lighter form) instead of a separate recipe.
No Blender was used, per the user instruction.
The project-technology recorder failed (missing PROJECT_DEPENDENCIES.json); Canvas 2D is native and GSAP is loaded from the host-provided local gsap.min.js.
Georgia may be replaced by a fallback serif in the render environment; the copy is unchanged.
